pluginJson.description: Stop hook that checks whether the comments this session WROTE are true. Scoped to the session's diff, then three passes: names a comment cites must resolve, figures must agree with the doc the comment itself cites (rounding-aware), and epistemic hedges are unverified claims. What needs reading comprehension goes to an external model with the evidence already resolved -- one bounded call, no repo exploration. No API key = the mechanical passes still block.
pluginJson.name: comment-truth
